mintAuthority.headline: Brix’s multisig can authorize uncapped issuance; public reserve reporting does not constrain the token’s mint function.
mintAuthority.summary: At Ethereum block 26423424 (2026-11-15T22:33:59Z), the iTRY default administrator is a three-of-five Safe. The current iTryIssuer holds the mint role, but the administrator can authorize another minter without a collateral or numerical cap. The ordinary issuer path transfers DLF collateral before minting and maintains an internal issuance ledger; that path does not constrain an administrator-selected replacement minter. Whole-liability independent reconciliation and prudential issuer supervision remain unverified.

controls.evidence: Pinned owner() returned the Safe and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true. The current issuer 0x9a40dce442013e6664c308016206da4ba2a9e824 has MINTER_CONTRACT=true; the Safe itself has MINTER_CONTRACT=false. iTry.addMinter and grantRole allow the administrator to add a chosen mint-capable address; iTry.mint(address,uint256) performs _mint without a collateral check or supply ceiling. getThreshold=3 and getOwners=5; modules pagination terminated at the sentinel with no modules, the guard slot was zero, VERSION=1.4.1 and the standard fallback-handler slot was populated. Signer independence, key custody and exhaustive current minter membership were not established.

review.evidence: The block hash is 0x6c345ceffeb90c07e2a1a17c1d462474c88927f4814c8108f2d87d0963b2e7ed, timestamp 2026-11-15T22:33:59Z; matching before/after headers bind every admitted read. Verified ERC1967Proxy exposes only fallback/receive delegation; its current iTry implementation exposes no upgrade selector, arbitrary delegatecall or implementation-slot setter, so the former wiTRY parent-upgrade claim is not repeated. The observed iTryIssuer ledger is 105526364.307175497186410053 iTRY while canonical totalSupply is 105526365.307175497186410053 iTRY; this is a disclosed internal workflow, not independent whole-liability reconciliation. Bridge representation controls remain in Bridge Risk.
